text:
jordan_sales: Triton Insurance just pinged — they need Private deployment with KMS + on-prem option, 99.95% SLA, and go-live by 2025-06-01. Want a firm commit by EOD for procurement. Can product confirm feasible?
maria_pm: Thanks. what's their hard constraints vs wish-list? Do they require full Private on day 1 or can we start hosted + private later?
alex_product: Short answer: we can do a phased approach. Constraints: KMS/HSM integration + audit logs are non-negotiable. On-prem we'll need infra sizing & install window. Can offer Dedicated reserved capacity as intermediate.
lee_engineer: Current Dedicated pool has 2 x A100 free in June; on-prem packaging requires ops time ~3 weeks + install doc. KMS integration 5-7 dev days with our KMS adapter.
sam_se: For model footprint — Triton expects 2048 token average, 8k max. If they want SOTA open model with quantization, we'll need to validate LL50 variant. Time for validation ~10 days.
maria_pm: So realistic timeline: procurement sign by 2025-04-15 -> reserved capacity + KMS by 2025-05-10 -> canary PV by 2025-05-20 -> full cutover 2025-06-01 only if we accept limited features (no streaming).
jordan_sales: They will push for full features. Procurement is tight: they cannot accept 'no streaming'. Is there any wiggle room on SLA or streaming rollout?
alex_product: Streaming adds complexity (continuous batching + KV-cache sync) to Private on-prem. If they insist, push cutover to 2025-06-15 to be safe. Alternatively we do Hosted with streaming from day 1, then switch to Private later.
deploy_bot: note: reserving Dedicated capacity for triton-insurance will consume 2 GPUs in us-east-1 from 2025-05-01 to 2025-09-01. Reply 'reserve' to confirm.
jordan_sales: They asked for a firm go-live 2025-06-01 in contract. We need to give procurement something. Maria — can we commit to 'canary with streaming disabled' on 6/1 and full streaming by 6/15?
maria_pm: Yes — we can commit to that if legal accepts staged feature clause. I'll draft SOW language today. Action items:
- @lee_engineer: KMS adapter delivery by 2025-05-10
- @sam_se: model validation for LL50 by 2025-05-07
- @alex_product: confirm canary runbook + rollback plan
- @jordan_sales: get procurement signoff by 2025-04-15
alex_product: ACK. Canary runbook snippet:
```
canary: 5% traffic -> monitor P50/P95 latency, error rate
rollback: immediate switch to hosted route if errors > 1% or tail latency > 2s
metrics: token cost, latency, success-rate
```
I'll post full doc in product-runbooks.
lee_engineer: I'll block calendar and start KMS work tomorrow. ETA 5/9.
One ask: need customer's KMS endpoint and certs by 2025-04-25.
sam_se: I'll start model perf tests today, will ping once LL50 passes perf regression. ETA 5/6.
jordan_sales: Thanks all. I'll push for procurement signoff and collect KMS details. I'll reply here with contract redline by EOD.
maria_pm: :thumbsup:
